containerExtraEnv.description: Container EnvVar entries added to this component (valueFrom allowed). A name patchy sets itself (PATCHY_*, POD_NAMESPACE, DOCKER_CONFIG) fails the render.

containerExtraEnvFrom.description: Container EnvFromSource entries, listed before the chart's own ConfigMap so the chart's keys win a clash.

podExtraVolumes.description: Pod Volume entries added to this component, rendered verbatim.

containerExtraVolumeMounts.description: VolumeMount entries added to this component's container, rendered verbatim.

agentQuantity.description: A positive Kubernetes quantity, quoted or not: 4, 0.5, 3500m, 8Gi. intent-controller and the job controllers check it further at startup (between 10m and 64 CPUs or 128Mi and 512Gi of memory, a request at or below its limit).

agentResourceClass.description: One named size: requests.cpu, requests.memory and limits.memory are required; limits.cpu is optional.

logLevel.description: slog level for the controller's stderr logger

imageOverride.description: Key-by-key override of the global image; digest pins and beats any tag

agentBudget.description: Turn and output-token budget for one authorization mode

idleTimeout.description: End a run that makes no progress (no model turn, no tool result) for this long; 0s disables it

auto.description: What an unattended fix gets, and the line past which an estimate needs approval

manual.description: The most a human approval can grant; must be at or above auto

idleTimeout.description: End a run that makes no progress (no model turn, no tool result) for this long; 0s disables it

provider.description: Brokered-claude model provider: which API the egress broker fronts and how canonical model ids map onto it. Ignored for non-claude runners.

region.description: Provider region; required for bedrock and vertex

regionPrefix.description: Bedrock inference-profile prefix override (us/eu/apac) when it cannot be derived from the region

projectID.description: GCP project id; required for vertex

resource.description: Microsoft Foundry resource name; required for foundry

modelMap.description: Canonical model id -> provider-specific id overrides; required for foundry (deployment names)

env.description: Extra agent-pod env for the provider; credential names are rejected at controller startup

registry.description: One credentialed upstream registry (egressProxy.registries.<name>). The egress proxy re-validates it at startup (netprofile.ParseRegistries); TestChartRegistrySchemaMatchesValidator keeps these rules in step with that validator, and patchy.egressProxyGuard holds what a schema cannot say (the deny list, CIDR overlaps, CodeArtifact host agreement).

ecosystem.description: The package protocol: go (GOPROXY), npm, or pypi (PEP 503 simple)

url.description: The https base URL; for pypi the index URL ending /simple/. A port other than 443 needs internal

type.description: none, bearer (Secret key token), basic (keys username, password) or codeartifact (minted with egressProxy.cloudCredentials)

secretName.description: bearer and basic only: a Secret in the release namespace that the operator creates; mounted into the egress proxy alone

domainOwner.description: The 12-digit AWS account id owning the domain (quote it in YAML)

fileHosts.description: pypi: further exact https hosts the index links files to, fetched without the credential

redirectHosts.description: Exact hosts or *.suffix patterns (three labels or more after the *) a 3xx may lead to; followed without the credential

internal.description: Opt-in: the registry resolves to a private or in-cluster address

cidrs.description: The only addresses the proxy dials for this registry, on the URL's port: IPv4, /24 or narrower; a /32 inside agent.networkPolicy.clusterCIDRs

podSelector.description: An in-cluster registry's pods, for the proxy's NetworkPolicy

targetPort.description: The registry pods' container port, when it differs from the URL's (Service) port; needs podSelector

privateModules.description: go: module prefixes only this registry serves; never looked up in sum.golang.org, refused on the public go route (GONOSUMDB in the pod). Required for go, possibly empty

publicChecksumLookups.description: go: whether other modules this registry serves may be checked against the public sum.golang.org. Required for go

maxArtifactBytes.description: Largest tarball, wheel or zip passed through; 0 is the proxy's default (512 MiB)

healthPackage.description: Optional: a package the credential can always read, fetched once after repeated 403s to tell a dead credential from curation

ca.description: A CA bundle in a release-namespace ConfigMap; the registry then trusts only it

registryGrant.description:
One profile's grant of one registry (agent.networkProfiles.

.registries.): exactly one of packages or packagePolicy registry

packages.description: An allowlist: go module prefixes, npm names or @scope/*, pip project names

packagePolicy.description: registry: the registry's own curation is the policy, and any well-formed name is forwarded

allowPrerelease.description: npm: admit prerelease and build versions

networkProfile.description: One operator dependency-route profile (agent.networkProfiles.<name>). The job controllers and the egress proxy re-validate it at startup (netprofile.Validate), including compiling the repository patterns; TestChartProfileSchemaMatchesValidator keeps these patterns in step with that validator.

route.description: The public dependency route the profile opens: go (GOPROXY and the checksum database to proxy.golang.org and sum.golang.org, plus a tunnel to hosts when it lists them) or tunnel (an HTTPS CONNECT tunnel to hosts only). Optional when the profile holds registry grants

port.description: The egress-proxy listener serving this profile alone; unique across profiles and never the health port 8081

host.description: The lowercase forge host the repositories live on

repositories.description: RE2 patterns matched anchored against a repository's lowercased owner/name

modules.description: Module-path prefixes the proxy forwards, matched on path-element boundaries; never golang.org itself or golang.org/toolchain (a render guard refuses those)

bakedModCache.description: The image's GOMODCACHE, served read-only after the proxy: an absolute clean path (no . or .. element, no trailing slash), or empty for the network only

allowPseudoVersions.description: Admit v0.0.0-<time>-<commit> versions of allowed modules; off, only tagged releases are forwarded

registries.description: Grants of egressProxy.registries entries, keyed by registry name; at most one per ecosystem (a render guard)

hosts.description: Exact public host names the egress proxy opens an HTTPS CONNECT tunnel to (443 only): lowercase, two or more labels, the last starting with a letter; no wildcard, IP address or trailing dot. Forges, model APIs, managed Kubernetes control planes, in-cluster names and publish endpoints are refused by a render guard

clients.description: Client env presets the tunnel Jobs get (proxy names and noise switches per package manager); only with hosts

upload.description: This profile's tunnel upload caps in bytes, overriding egressProxy.tunnel.maxUploadBytes and sourceUploadBudget; only with hosts, perTunnel at most perSource (a render guard)

extraEgress.description: Verbatim NetworkPolicy egress rules appended to the controller's policy (e.g. a generic Integration endpoint on a port other than 443).

clusterDNSCIDR.description: The node-local cluster DNS address as a /32 (EKS Auto Mode: the cluster DNS Service IP); empty renders no rule

mode.description: required: every slot Pod selects the preview nodes and tolerates their taint; none: neither, an explicit opt-out

selector.description: Node label to value every slot Pod selects, merged with eksAutoMode's two labels

eksAutoMode.description: EKS Auto Mode: the dedicated NodePool and its DefaultDeny NodeClass, each filling one selector label; both or neither

role.description: IAM role name, not an ARN

imagePathPrefix.description: Registry path every preview image sits directly under (<imageRegistry>/<imagePathPrefix>/<app>): lowercase ECR path segments joined by '/', no leading or trailing slash, never empty, and disjoint from every agent.repositoryImages.registries entry

prefixListsIDs.description: Managed prefix list IDs the preview ALB admits beside inboundCIDRs; optional

allowPublicWithAuth.description: Rev C only: confirmed lets inboundCIDRs and prefixListsIDs be empty (sign-in alone guards the preview ALB); needs previewAuth.stage require and previewAuth.sessionTimeout <= 900

previewAuth.description: The preview sign-in relay (cmd/preview-auth): every preview Ingress authenticated through it, off by default; permit (B1) then require (B2)

teams.description: Dex GitHub group names, <org>:<team-slug> by default; the chart prepends claims.groupsPrefix

users.description: GitHub logins; the chart prepends claims.usernamePrefix

crds.description: patchy.bitwisemedia.uk CRD installation; keep guards the all-time FindingRollup data on uninstall

attribution.description: Run attribution (design L1): whom every agent run is for. off changes nothing; attribute stamps spec.attributedTo on new runs and the attributed-to annotation on agent Jobs and pods, and renders the attribution admission policies.

mode.description: off (default) or attribute. Reaches investigation-, remediation-, intent- and evaluation-controller as PATCHY_ATTRIBUTION_MODE only when attribute.

admissionPolicy.description: Field-level authorization for the human finding actions. Binds each human-writable spec field to its own custom RBAC verb via a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (Kubernetes 1.30+).

enabled.description: Render the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy. Disabling it makes the custom finding verbs advisory: anyone holding `update` on findings could then change any field.

extraExemptSubjects.description: Additional usernames exempt from the policy, for a controller of your own that legitimately writes Finding spec. The chart's own components are exempted automatically.

jobControllerUsernames.description: With egressProxy: the usernames the Kubernetes Job controller creates Pods as. A Pod carrying a network profile label in agent.namespace is admitted only from one of these, with a controlling owner reference to a batch/v1 Job. Default system:serviceaccount:kube-system:job-controller (kube-controller-manager under --use-service-account-credentials).

edgeIngressClass.description: An EKS Auto Mode IngressClass + IngressClassParams for the webhook and status-page Ingresses; off by default

loadBalancerName.description: Also the ALB group name, so lowercase

webhook.description: The single external entry point for the provider webhook URL, fronting the integration-controller (path /github/webhooks)

evaluationController.description: The remote-evaluation engine: the evolve-facing authenticated HTTP API plus the reconcilers running submitted units in sandboxed agent Jobs. Optional, off by default.

config.description: Inline auth config rendered into a chart-managed Secret (config.yaml: mode none|oidc); prefer existingSecret in production

runners.description: The evolve-runner fleet: full image references shipped from the evolve repository, pinned by the operator; credentials reuse agent.runners.<harness>.

intentController.description: Intent-driven development: polls each Project's intent repository, plans in a read-only agent Job, builds the approved plan and opens the pull request. Optional, off by default; runs on brokered claude only.

multiRepo.description: Run intents of Projects that list more than one repository; off, their intents are held Blocked

rateLimitFloor.description: Pause polling below this many remaining core requests; 0 disables

plan.description: The plan stage's ceilings: read-only, on the default runner image

model.description: Canonical model id; must resolve to the claude harness

idleTimeout.description: End a run of the stage that makes no progress (no model turn, no tool result) for this long; 0s disables it

build.description: The build stage's ceilings: workspace-write, on the repository's accepted image

model.description: Canonical model id; must resolve to the claude harness

idleTimeout.description: End a run of the stage that makes no progress (no model turn, no tool result) for this long; 0s disables it

revise.description: The revise and check-fix stage's ceilings: workspace-write, on the build round's pinned repository image

idleTimeout.description: End a run of the stage that makes no progress (no model turn, no tool result) for this long; 0s disables it

forgeSecrets.description: The Secrets the Forges reference; intent-controller's secrets get is restricted to these names (an empty list would grant every Secret, so it is refused)

statusServer.description: The human-facing status page: public rollup statistics, authenticated findings review, RBAC-gated approve/suspend/resume

liveTranscripts.description: Stream a running agent's conversation into the status page; grants pod and pod-log read in the agent namespace.

intents.description: The read-only intents views (board, timeline, run panel) with per-Project access reviews. Needs auth mode oidc with usernamePrefix and groupsPrefix, and hardens the whole page's browser envelope.

config.description: Inline auth config rendered into a chart-managed Secret (config.yaml); prefer existingSecret in production

egressBroker.description: The egress credential broker all claude model traffic goes through; deploys exactly when a claude runner is enabled

limits.description: Broker-side enforcement (the egress-broker's limit flags); 0 or empty keeps the binary's default, which is off unless noted

requestsPerPod.description: Requests one agent pod may make in its lifetime

concurrentPerPod.description: In-flight requests one agent pod may hold

concurrencyWait.description: How long a request over concurrentPerPod waits for a slot (Go duration; empty is the binary's default, negative refuses at once)

tokensPerPod.description: Tokens (input, cache creation, cache read, output) one agent pod may consume

maxTokensCeiling.description: Largest max_tokens a request may set

modelAllowlist.description: Model ids pods may name; empty admits every model

betaDenylist.description: anthropic-beta glob patterns to strip; empty keeps the built-in list, [none] strips nothing

maxAnthropicRequestBytes.description: Largest buffered request body on the anthropic, vertex and foundry routes; 0 is the binary's default

maxRequestBytes.description: Largest request body on the payload-signing bedrock route; 0 is the binary's default

preauthRequestsPerSecond.description: Per-source-IP request rate admitted before authentication

preauthBurst.description: Per-source-IP burst and in-flight cap before authentication

anthropicSecret.description: Secret (release namespace) holding the Anthropic API key under api-key; the broker is its only consumer

anthropicAuth.description: How the Anthropic credential authenticates: key (x-api-key) or token (Authorization bearer, a claude setup-token OAuth token)

foundrySecret.description: Secret (release namespace) holding the Foundry API key under api-key; empty selects Entra via the broker's workload identity

egressProxy.description: The egress proxy: the operator's Go dependency route for profile Jobs; off by default and chart-only

suspendProfiles.description: The kill switch: the job controllers apply no profile from their next Job, and the proxy answers every profile request 410 suspended

limits.description: The proxy's limit flags; 0 or empty keeps the binary's default

attribution.description: Best-effort audit attribution of source IPs to agent pods; needs the API server's endpoint IPs as /32s

tunnel.description:
The CONNECT tunnel's limits (agent.networkProfiles.

.hosts); rendered only while some profile lists hosts. 0 or empty keeps the binary's default

denyCIDRs.description: IPv4 CIDRs the tunnel never dials beside attribution.apiServerCIDRs: a public Kubernetes API endpoint the hard-deny names do not cover

sourceBudgetIdle.description: Hours, minutes and seconds only (2h, 90m, 1h30m); never below the longest agent or intent Job deadline (a render guard). Empty: 2h, or that deadline when longer

registries.description: Credentialed upstream registries a profile can be granted, keyed by name

cloudCredentials.description: The proxy's own AWS identity for codeartifact registries: none, irsa (role annotation on egressProxy.serviceAccount) or podIdentity (adds egress to the node-local Pod Identity agent)

extraEgress.description: Verbatim NetworkPolicy egress rules appended to the proxy's policy (an in-cluster OTLP collector, say); the proxy's dialer still governs every forwarded request

paused.description: The cluster-wide pause: no new agent Jobs from investigation-, remediation-, intent- or evaluation-controller; running Jobs finish.

resources.description: CPU and memory for the agent Jobs: the default every one gets, and the named classes a Project picks per repository for its intent builds. Ephemeral storage is agent.repositoryImages.ephemeralStorage, not a key here.

classes.description: Class name (a DNS label of at most 32 characters) to its size; at most 16. The largest is the most any one agent Job can request.

repositoryImages.description: Repository-declared runner images: a watched repository names the image its claude agent runs in; off by default, and enabling it fails the render unless the required values are set and the agent egress is narrow

enabled.description: The kill switch; false renders none of the keys below

registries.description: Registry path prefixes (host/path/) a declared image must sit under; required when enabled

items.description: host[:port]/segment[/segment...][/]: at least one path segment, no tag, digest, glob, comma or whitespace (source-controller refuses such an entry at startup)

cosignPublicKey.description: PEM public key every declared image must be cosign-signed with; required when enabled unless allowUnsigned

allowUnsigned.description: Admit unsigned images (explicit opt-out of signature verification)

maxBytes.description: Largest compressed layer total of one platform of a declared image, in bytes

onReject.description: What a rejected declaration does to the finding: run it on the default image (default) or park it for a human (handoff)

ephemeralStorage.description: Ephemeral-storage request and limit on both agent containers, a positive unsigned quantity with an optional binary (Ki..Ei) or decimal (k, M..E) suffix such as 8Gi; required when enabled

changesetMaxEntries.description: Most files a changeset from a repository-image run may touch

pullSecret.description: dockerconfigjson Secret (release namespace) source-controller resolves declared images with, mounted optional; also listed in the agent ServiceAccount's imagePullSecrets

pullSecretData.description: The .dockerconfigjson content (JSON, not base64) rendered as the pullSecret Secret in both the release namespace and agent.namespace

networkProfiles.description: Operator dependency-route profiles keyed by name; inert unless egressProxy.enabled

mode.description: Hostname-enforcement dialect for the agent sandbox; auto detects it from the cluster's API surface

broadEgress.description: Whether the base policy keeps its TCP-443-to-anywhere rule; auto drops it whenever a hostname mode is enforcing, because policies are additive

dns.description: How agent pods resolve names: cluster (the cluster resolver) or none (no resolver; the job controllers pin the artifact server and the egress broker in each pod's hosts file and the agent egress drops its DNS rules; brokered claude only)
